speakers.query: SELECT count(*) FROM schubert.speakers WHERE ((id BETWEEN 1 AND 999999999999) AND (octet_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 128) AND (octet_length(normalized_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 128)) IS FALSE

script_files.query:
SELECT count(*) FROM schubert.script_files WHERE ((byte_size BETWEEN 0 AND 999999999999) AND (
        chapter_title IS NULL OR octet_length(chapter_title) <= 256) AND (display_order BETWEEN 1 AND 999999999999) AND (octet_length(display_path) BETWEEN 1 AND 512) AND (octet_length(file_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 256) AND (id BETWEEN 1 AND 999999999999) AND (sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') AND (octet_length(storage_relative_path) BETWEEN 1 AND 512) AND (
        storage_relative_path !~ '(^/|\\|(^|/)\.\.?(/|$)|//)')) IS FALSE

checks.ck_script_entries_speaker_by_type:
(entry_type = 'dialogue' AND speaker_id IS NOT NULL)
        OR (entry_type = 'narration' AND speaker_id IS NULL)

script_entries.query:
SELECT count(*) FROM schubert.script_entries WHERE ((octet_length(body) BETWEEN 1 AND 4096) AND (display_order BETWEEN 1 AND 999999999999) AND (entry_index >= 0) AND (entry_type IN ('dialogue', 'narration')) AND (id BETWEEN 1 AND 999999999999) AND (line_number IS NULL OR line_number >= 1) AND (
        (entry_type = 'dialogue' AND speaker_id IS NOT NULL)
        OR (entry_type = 'narration' AND speaker_id IS NULL)) AND (
        speaker_label IS NULL OR octet_length(speaker_label) <= 128)) IS FALSE

checks.ck_audio_files_duration_ms: duration_ms IS NULL OR duration_ms BETWEEN 0 AND 999999999999

audio_files.query:
SELECT count(*) FROM schubert.audio_files WHERE ((octet_length(audio_role) BETWEEN 1 AND 8) AND (octet_length(basename) BETWEEN 1 AND 255) AND (byte_size BETWEEN 1 AND 999999999999) AND (octet_length(display_path) BETWEEN 1 AND 512) AND (duration_ms IS NULL OR duration_ms BETWEEN 0 AND 999999999999) AND (octet_length(file_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 256) AND (id BETWEEN 1 AND 999999999999) AND (sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') AND (octet_length(storage_relative_path) BETWEEN 1 AND 512) AND (
        storage_relative_path !~ '(^/|\\|(^|/)\.\.?(/|$)|//)')) IS FALSE

checks.ck_media_assets_pair:
(
        (media_type = 'VIDEO' AND pair_key IS NULL AND pair_role IS NULL)
        OR (media_type = 'MUSIC' AND (
            (pair_role IN ('M', 'I') AND octet_length(pair_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 256)
            OR (pair_role = 'N' AND pair_key IS NULL)))
    ) IS TRUE

media_assets.query:
SELECT count(*) FROM schubert.media_assets WHERE ((byte_size BETWEEN 1 AND 999999999999) AND (octet_length(category) BETWEEN 1 AND 64) AND (display_order BETWEEN 1 AND 9999) AND (octet_length(display_path) BETWEEN 1 AND 512) AND (octet_length(file_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 256) AND (id BETWEEN 1 AND 999999999999) AND (octet_length(logical_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 64) AND (media_type IN ('VIDEO', 'MUSIC')) AND (
        mime_type IN ('video/mp4', 'audio/mp4', 'audio/mpeg', 'audio/ogg', 'audio/wav', 'audio/flac')) AND ((
        (media_type = 'VIDEO' AND pair_key IS NULL AND pair_role IS NULL)
        OR (media_type = 'MUSIC' AND (
            (pair_role IN ('M', 'I') AND octet_length(pair_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 256)
            OR (pair_role = 'N' AND pair_key IS NULL)))
    ) IS TRUE) AND (section IS NULL OR octet_length(section) <= 128) AND (sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') AND (octet_length(storage_relative_path) BETWEEN 1 AND 512) AND (
        storage_relative_path !~ '(^/|\\|(^|/)\.\.?(/|$)|//)') AND (octet_length(title) BETWEEN 1 AND 256)) IS FALSE

entry_audio_links.query: SELECT count(*) FROM schubert.entry_audio_links WHERE ((display_order BETWEEN 1 AND 999) AND (link_type IN ('voice', 'se', 'bgm', 'other'))) IS FALSE
